name: epsper
label: epsilon Per (B0.5 III, spectroscopic binary 14.07 d)
sources: Wikipedia infobox (read 2026-10-08) and the papers it cites: V 2.88, B0.5 III, SB 14.07 d, T_eff 26500 K, R 7.66 Rsun, M 13.5 Msun, d 196 pc
notes: No interferometric diameter exists: theta_LD = 2R/d = 0.363 mas from the quoted radius and distance; the Pathfinder would be its first measurement.
Claret & Bloemen 2011 linear law of Spica (hot B star) as the limb-darkening fallback; NewEra does not cover T_eff > 12 000 K.
Spectroscopic binary (P 14.07 d) whose secondary contributes little light; a tertiary (~26 yr) is unconfirmed.
